titleEn: What is ‘food is medicine’? – 2 experts explain this decades-old approach to healthcare that is taking on new life
titleZh: 什么是“食物即良药”？一种历史悠久的医疗理念如何重获关注
method: Machine reference translation with paragraph alignment; not manually certified.

paragraphs.en: Mountains of scientific evidence support both the negative and positive effects of our eating habits on our health. Research shows that a healthy diet can help those suffering from chronic health conditions like Type 2 diabetes, heart disease and high blood pressure.
paragraphs.zh: 大量的科学证据支持我们的饮食习惯对我们的健康既有负面影响，也有正面影响。研究表明，健康的饮食可以帮助那些患有2型糖尿病、心脏病和高血压等慢性疾病的人。

paragraphs.en: This is where “food is medicine” comes in. Food is medicine, also known as “food as medicine” and “food prescriptions,” is a movement dedicated to providing healthy food – fruits, vegetables and sometimes healthy proteins – based on a clinician’s prescription in order to prevent, manage or treat specific clinical conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 这就是“食物即药物”的由来。食物即药物，也被称为“食物即药物”和“食物处方”，是一项致力于根据临床医生的处方提供健康食物的运动-水果，蔬菜，有时是健康的蛋白质，以预防，管理或治疗特定的临床疾病。

paragraphs.en: Prescribing food to patients is intended to convey that food is just as important as medication for health and wellness.
paragraphs.zh: 给病人开食物处方的目的是传达食物与药物对健康和健康同样重要。

paragraphs.en: As researchers whose work focuses on food access and health in rural communities, we have firsthand experience running food is medicine programs in our local area in northern Mississippi. This experience has shown us the benefits and limitations of these programs in our community.
paragraphs.zh: 作为研究人员，他们的工作重点是农村社区的食物获取和健康，我们有第一手的经验，运行食品是药品计划在我们当地的北方密西西比。这一经验向我们展示了这些计划在我们的社区的好处和局限性。

paragraphs.en: Fighting food insecurity
paragraphs.zh: 消除粮食不安全

paragraphs.en: Food is medicine programs can be delivered through curated food boxes, grocery vouchers and medically tailored meals. Most programs are collaborations between nonprofit organizations, health clinics and healthcare providers. The goal of food is medicine is to improve patient health, especially for those with chronic conditions, while reducing healthcare costs.
paragraphs.zh: 食品即药品项目可以通过精心策划的食品盒、杂货券和医疗定制餐来提供。大多数项目是非营利组织、健康诊所和医疗保健提供者之间的合作。食品即药品项目的目标是改善患者的健康状况，特别是慢性病患者的健康状况，同时降低医疗保健成本。

paragraphs.en: Increasingly, food is medicine programs have become lifelines for people with food insecurity. In 2024, more than 47 million Americans, including 7.3 million children, lived in food-insecure households – meaning they were at some point uncertain of having, or did not have, enough food for everyone in the household.
paragraphs.zh: 食品即药品计划已越来越多地成为粮食不安全人群的生命线。2024年，超过4700万美国人，包括730万儿童，生活在粮食不安全的家庭中-这意味着他们在某个时候不确定是否有或没有足够的食物供家庭中的每个人食用。

paragraphs.en: Internationally, the number of people experiencing hunger rises to roughly 673 million. Rural populations are more likely to be food insecure due to the loss of local grocery stores and distance from urban centers. Unlike a food bank, food is medicine programs provide only healthy foods, which are often curated by a dietitian, to optimize patient health.
paragraphs.zh: 在国际上，经历饥饿的人数上升到大约6.73亿。由于当地杂货店的消失和远离城市中心，农村人口更有可能处于粮食不安全状态。与食品银行不同，食品即药品计划只提供健康食品，这些食品通常由营养师策划，以优化患者健康。

paragraphs.en: Forward momentum
paragraphs.zh: 前进动力

paragraphs.en: Though food is medicine isn’t formally connected to the Make American Healthy Again movement, U.S. Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. has brought new energy and attention to the concept. In January 2026, the second Trump administration launched a campaign encouraging Americans to “Eat Real Food.”
paragraphs.zh: 尽管“食品即药物”与“让美国人再次健康”运动没有正式联系，但美国卫生与公众服务部部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪为这一概念带来了新的活力和关注。2026年1月，特朗普第二届政府发起了一项运动，鼓励美国人“吃真实的食物”。

paragraphs.en: But the food is medicine movement actually began more than 60 years ago. One of the early providers who prescribed food as medicine was civil rights activist and multiple Nobel Peace Prize winner Dr. Jack Geiger. In the 1960s, he co-founded community health centers in South Boston and the Mississippi Delta.
paragraphs.zh: 但食品即药物运动实际上始于60多年前。早期将食品作为药物的供应商之一是民权活动家和多次诺贝尔和平奖赢家杰克盖革博士。20世纪60年代，他在南波士顿和密西西比三角洲共同创立了社区卫生中心。

paragraphs.en: When government officials chastised him for prescribing food to patients in the Delta, Geiger responded, “The last time I looked at my textbooks, the most specific therapy for malnutrition was food.”
paragraphs.zh: 当政府官员指责他给三角洲地区的病人开食物处方时，盖革回应说：“上次我看教科书时，营养不良最具体的疗法就是食物。”

paragraphs.en: Since then, thousands of community organizations like Community Servings and Project Open Hand have provided healthy food to vulnerable community members.
paragraphs.zh: 从那时起，数以千计的社区组织，如社区服务和项目开放的手，提供健康的食物，以弱势社区成员。

paragraphs.en: In 2023, the president of the American Heart Association convened an advisory group of researchers and physicians to review current food is medicine research and suggest next steps for work in this area. This advisory has suggested that these programs could help prevent or manage chronic conditions, saving the U.S. healthcare system an estimated US$4.3 trillion annually.
paragraphs.zh: 2023年，美国心脏协会主席召集了一个由研究人员和医生组成的咨询小组，审查当前的食品即药物研究，并建议该领域的下一步工作。该咨询建议这些计划可以帮助预防或管理慢性疾病，每年为美国医疗保健系统节省约4.3万亿美元。

paragraphs.en: Food is medicine has also started to gain international momentum. In 2025, the Rockefeller Foundation supported a meeting of international scholars, policy experts and practitioners that established the Food Is Medicine Global Alliance. This organization plans to help integrate, sustainably finance and routinely deliver food is medicine programs worldwide by 2030. So far, it has released several reports highlighting the current food is medicine environment and made resources available to providers looking to start their own programs.
paragraphs.zh: 食品即药物也开始获得国际动力。2025年，洛克菲勒基金会支持了一次由国际学者、政策专家和从业人员参加的会议，该会议成立了食品即药物全球联盟。该组织计划到2030年帮助整合、可持续地资助并定期在全球范围内提供食品即药物项目。到目前为止，它发布了几份报告，强调当前的食品即药品环境，并为希望启动自己的方案的供应商提供资源。

paragraphs.en: Food is medicine in our local community
paragraphs.zh: 在我们当地社区食物就是药物

paragraphs.en: Food is medicine programs can use food from local farms or grocery stores, and the means of getting the food to patients varies. The four projects we have run to date have been relatively small and local.
paragraphs.zh: 食品即药品项目可以使用当地农场或杂货店的食品，将食品送到患者手中的方式各不相同。我们迄今为止开展的四个项目规模相对较小，而且都是本地化的。

paragraphs.en: One was a food box pickup program that supplemented fruits and vegetables for 55 households whose members demonstrated food insecurity. We followed the participants for two years and found statistically significant reductions in weight, waist circumference and triglyceride levels in the primary adult participants.
paragraphs.zh: 其中一个是食品盒采摘计划，为55个家庭成员证明粮食不安全的补充水果和蔬菜。我们跟踪参与者两年，发现主要成年参与者的体重，腰围和甘油三酯水平在统计学上显着下降。

paragraphs.en: For two of our other programs, including one that is ongoing, we partnered with local farmers. One was a pilot test of a food box delivery program for housebound people. Both the recipients of the food and the farmers reported high satisfaction with the program’s delivery and felt the program strengthened community connections while also supporting local agricultural livelihoods.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的其他两个项目中，包括一个正在进行的项目，我们与当地农民合作。其中一个是为足不出户的人提供食品盒交付项目的试点测试。食品接收者和农民都对该项目的交付表示高度满意，并认为该项目加强了社区联系，同时也支持了当地农业生计。

paragraphs.en: What other researchers have found
paragraphs.zh: 其他研究人员发现

paragraphs.en: One recent large-scale literature review identified 14 trials of food is medicine interventions and found that these approaches often positively influenced diet quality and food security.
paragraphs.zh: 最近的一项大规模文献综述确定了14项食品即药物干预试验，并发现这些方法通常对饮食质量和食品安全产生积极影响。

paragraphs.en: Another review of food is medicine programs for people with diabetes found significant increases in fruit and vegetable intake and reductions in blood sugar levels. This data supports our own previous findings.
paragraphs.zh: 另一项针对糖尿病患者的食品和药物计划的综述发现，水果和蔬菜的摄入量显著增加，血糖水平降低。

paragraphs.en: However, the effect of food is medicine programs on long-term health outcomes has been inconsistent, in part because many trials have been too small or not rigorous enough to determine causation. In some cases, the “dose” – that is, the amount of food provided – is limited by grant funding. Our food box pickup project supplemented only four to five meals each week, which may have been insufficient to significantly improve all health outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，食品即药物项目对长期健康结果的影响并不一致，部分原因是许多试验规模太小或不够严格，无法确定因果关系。在某些情况下，“剂量”--即提供的食物量--受到赠款资金的限制。我们的食品盒拾取项目每周只补充四到五顿饭，这可能不足以显著改善所有健康结果。

paragraphs.en: Moreover, it will be important for researchers to consider the logistics of making these programs work in various local food environments. Global factors like changing weather patterns and, more recently, delays in fuel and supplies from the Strait of Hormuz have increased prices of staple food products like cereals and vegetable oil and led to shortages of cooking oil in some countries.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，研究人员还必须考虑如何在不同的地方粮食环境中实施这些计划。气候模式变化等全球因素，以及最近霍尔木兹海峡的燃料和供应延误，都导致谷物和植物油等主食产品的价格上涨，并导致一些国家的食用油短缺。

paragraphs.en: Food is medicine can be appealing because it makes intuitive sense. But going forward, larger, high-quality studies are needed to adequately track clinical outcomes from the various types of food is medicine programming. If studies show food is medicine is beneficial, it could lead to a shift in how healthcare practitioners approach diet for patients with chronic illness. Access to healthy food would be considered as essential as medications for patients with chronic illness.
paragraphs.zh: 食物即药物可能很有吸引力，因为它具有直观的意义。但展望未来，需要更大规模，高质量的研究来充分跟踪各种类型的食物即药物规划的临床结果。如果研究表明食物即药物是有益的，这可能会导致医疗保健从业者改变慢性病患者的饮食方式。获得健康食品将被视为与药物一样重要对于慢性病患者。
